content.selectionBasis: Registered locale cohorts ranked by retained lifetime correct plus incorrect attempts. Totals are shared across the languages of an exam and are not unique visitors, recent clicks, or country search volume.
content.recentClickLimitation: Only six exams had nonzero recent clicks (ten clicks total), insufficient for a reliable top ten in each language.
content.identityPolicy: Append after existing groups; preserve all prior question and choice IDs, prior question payloads, version IDs and archived content.
content.progressCompatibility: When an original-only batch expands, read compatible records from its shorter previous storage keys. Validate exam, locale, content version, page and question-ID prefix before reusing saved attempts, choice order and bookmarks.
content.storage: Original questions use the existing public authored-content repository and LearningStore overlay; no production database content insertion is needed. A code release is required for public availability.
content.legacyScope: Retired codes remain in existing routes. The supplemental sets review foundational topics and do not claim current replacement-exam blueprint alignment.
content.contentNature: Original single-best-answer study questions with explanations and related learning references; independent material rather than an official October exam paper. Not a full-length or adaptive exam simulation.

ko, ko-KR, en, en-US and en-CA alternates with a home-page x-default

releaseApproval.mechanism: One push to master, using the existing Vercel production Git integration; no CLI/API deployment and no prebuilt upload.
releaseApproval.postReleaseCheck: Small read-only smoke check of Korean and English October sets, an original question, sitemap and robots only; no hosted regression or crawling.
